Game Overview

Hero Buddy is a platformer title where embark on a daring rescue mission with Hero Buddy. Join Jackson on an action-packed quest to save Bruno, navigating treacherous terrain filled with obstacles and enemies. Experience fast-paced gameplay that challenges your reflexes and strategic skills as each level intensifies the excitement. Can you save your friend and emerge victorious?
